ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 40% high-intensity white and 60% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patch covering the distal half of the right lobe; smaller white patch on the distal tip of the left lobe; central region and base are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an approximate pixel angle of 85 degrees and moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge, with more pronounced jagged peaks at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the superior boundary of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, dark circular clusters visible within the white pigmentation area of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, vertical high-contrast white linear marks located on the dark central ventral surface to the right of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vertical rake marks on central dark pigmentation and irregular, jagged erosion at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in pigmentation distribution between the left and right fluke lobes.
